description:
Create a transactional Customer Satisfaction survey titled 'Zendesk Support Feedback 2025' that integrates with external CRM data. 

1. Create a 'System Data' question group with three Short Text questions (Codes: Q_Ticket, Q_Agent, Q_Channel). These questions must be set to 'Always hide this question' (in Display settings).

2. Configure Panel Integration (URL Parameters) to map these external parameters to the hidden questions:
   - 'ext_tid' -> Q_Ticket
   - 'ext_ag' -> Q_Agent
   - 'ext_chn' -> Q_Channel

3. Create a 'Customer Feedback' group with a visible List (Radio) question (Code: Satisfaction). The question text must use Expression Manager piping to say: 'How would you rate your recent **{Q_Channel}** support experience with **{Q_Agent}**?' (or similar text containing those placeholders).

4. Activate the survey.
